summary: Full MongoDB -> Convex cutover regression (backend only). 63/63 tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_convex_rest.py. Verified: FastAPI stub on :8001 returns {backend:convex, mongodb:false} and server.py has no motor/pymongo imports; Convex .site REST surface auth works for owner/agent/dev; bad/missing tokens -> 401 Arabic {detail}; role gates (agent->dev-only 403, owner->sales POST 403, agent->/employees 403, agent->/stats/alerts|finance|reports 403, unknown path 404); CORS OPTIONS preflight on both static and :param routes -> 204 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin:*; all 22 documented owner reads return 200 JSON (products, customers, sales, collections, stats/{overview,alerts,finance,reports,leaderboard}, notifications, org/profile, plans, settings/payment, routes, tracking/agents, employees, deliveries, inventory/distributors, purchases, payment-vouchers, stock-movements, price-history); public /app-version/latest 200 with no token; write transactions chain end-to-end asserting on returned ids: owner POST /products -> appears in /products -> POST /purchases (stock +10, cost_price updated to 600) -> appears in /purchases -> POST /deliveries to agent -> appears in /deliveries -> agent POST /deliveries/:id/confirm (inventory loaded) -> POST /sales (inventory decrements by 1) -> POST /collections (succeeds against sale's credit balance); owner POST /routes (using existing org customer; owner cannot create customers which is the correct agent-only gate) -> appears in /routes?date=; owner POST /employees/invite -> returns EMP- prefixed code; dev GET /dev/{stats,orgs,monitoring,licenses,versions} all 200.
action_items: Housekeeping (non-blocking): /app/backend/requirements.txt still pins motor==3.3.1 and pymongo==4.6.3 even though server.py never imports them. Safe to remove for a cleaner cutover.

Doc nit (non-blocking): /app/memory/test_credentials.md still mentions seed_test.py writing to Mongo (`seeds into Mongo (legacy)`). Since the Mongo path is retired, consider updating the doc to describe only the Convex auth:syncSession path for test token sync.
critical_code_review_comments: convex/http.ts handler is tight: dynamic :param routes get CORS from the shared CORS object, OPTIONS short-circuits to 204 for every /api/* path (verified against /api/sales/<id>/void), and Arabic error strings are mapped to HTTP codes via statusFor() (401/403/404/400) — matches the previous FastAPI behavior.

convex/products.ts::create uses `cost_price`/`sale_price` (not `cost`/`price` or `sku`) and strictly rejects extra fields via arg validator — frontend clients must send the right shape. Not a bug, just a schema contract to watch during the Expo UI migration.

Field agents are correctly gated out of staff-only stats endpoints (/stats/alerts, /stats/finance, /stats/reports) and /employees; /stats/overview, /stats/agents and /stats/leaderboard are intentionally ANY_ORG and return the agent's own slice via by_distributor indexes. The problem statement's phrasing 'STAFF-only /api/stats/*' is slightly broader than the code; the code's narrower gate is the intended design.

Owner is correctly NOT allowed to POST /customers — that route is AGENT-only (Arabic 'ليس لديك صلاحية'). Any UI that lets an owner add customers from the field will 403; routes/customer-import flows must stay agent-driven. This matches the pre-migration behavior.
FastAPI server.py is a 30-line stub with no motor/pymongo imports (verified by grep across non-comment lines). Only /api/ and /api/health remain locally; everything else must hit the Convex .site.

success_rate.backend: 100% — 63/63 pass against the live Convex .site deployment
success_rate.frontend: skipped per request (Google OAuth cannot be automated)

seed_data_creation: No new seed script was run. All seeded tokens (test_token_owner/agent/agent2/acct/dev) authenticated against Convex on first call (auth/me => 200), so no auth:syncSession re-sync was needed. Each write test prefixes rows with TEST_ and the autouse session cleanup fixture deletes the created route, invite and product at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with `-n 0` because the test file uses a module-level STATE dict that chains owner POSTs -> agent confirm/sale/collection (xdist loadscope would still work since all mutations live in one class, but -n 0 is safer). The Convex REST surface is at https://fearless-ostrich-878.eu-west-1.convex.site/api/*. Auth shape notes: /auth/me returns role='EMPLOYEE' + employee_type='FIELD_AGENT' for agent tokens, role='DEVELOPER' (not 'DEV') for the dev token, and role='OWNER' for owner. /org/profile returns the profile WITHOUT an id field (caller org is implicit). /notifications returns {items:[], unread:N} not a bare array. /dev/monitoring returns a list, not a dict. Product create arg schema: {name, category?, unit?, cost_price?, sale_price?, stock?, min_stock?} — no sku/price/cost. Purchase create: one product per call {product_id, quantity, unit_cost, supplier?}. Delivery items use `quantity` not `qty`. Agent customer create requires lat/lng. Owner is NOT allowed to POST /customers (agent-only).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug found. All 63 assertions pass against the live Convex deployment. The migration is clean: FastAPI holds no data, every REST route is served by convex/http.ts, role gates and Arabic error payloads behave identically to the previous FastAPI implementation, and write transactions keep products/inventory/balances consistent across the owner-purchase -> owner-delivery -> agent-confirm -> agent-sale -> agent-collection chain.
